sentences.en: I always get disorientated in underground car parks.
sentences.zh: 我总是会在地下停车场迷失方向。

sentences.en: The Algerian government is disorientated by the massive protests currently taking place in Algeria.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚政府被目前在阿尔及利亚爆发的大规模抗议活动弄得措手不及。

sentences.en: Tom is still groggy and disorientated.
sentences.zh: 汤姆还在迷糊中，显得有些迷茫。

senses.zh: 使失去方向感；使（某人）神智迷乱
